title: Trade and International Business: Research & Analysis | CSIS
text:
Trade and International Business

Reciprocal tariffs, threats to global supply chains, and comparative manufacturing advantages have disrupted the established global trade system. CSIS scholars provide analysis and commentary on the international trading system and its institutions.

America’s Unproven Productivity Boom, and the Cost of Misreading the Data

The recent boom in U.S. labor productivity may not be early dividends of new AI technologies, but a routine labor market adjustment. Until the data starts to provide a clearer story, policymakers would be wise to consider the jury out to avoid serious policy missteps.
